name: Toei Company, Ltd.
summary: Toei Company, Ltd., a content company, engages in the production and distribution of movies, television (TV) shows, and other video products in Japan. The company produces and distributes theatrical films, TV programs, and educational videos; engages in the video licensing business; produces and sells CDs, DVDs, Blu-ray discs, and games; licenses character merchandising rights and copyrights of films and programs; manages theaters and cinema complexes; and runs character shows related to films and videos. It also produces, plans, and holds cultural events; operates TOEI Kyoto studio park and Kyoto film studio; and engages in the construction work and contract interior decoration activities, …
